bundle.shortDescription: Card-driven 3D tower stacking with online multiplayer.
bundle.longDescription: Tower Stack is a digital adaptation of the card-driven dexterity stacking game. Draw a card, place a block on the wobbly tower, and don't be the one who topples it. Online multiplayer powered by Cloudflare. Compatible with Steam and Itch.io distribution.
